responsibility: Defines the Feature value type that represents a Rust language or compiler gate known to the frontend. It owns the stable enums for feature state and canonical feature names plus accessors and factory/lookup declarations, so other passes can convert attribute strings into structured feature records carrying issue, edition, version, and description metadata for gating decisions and diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: Declares the Feature class, enums, stored metadata fields, and factory/lookup interface that the companion .cc file populates; unlike the implementation file, it provides the type and API surface but not the concrete feature table or name map definitions.
